method: Every firm below was discovered through a public web search for San Francisco plumbing contractors, then each licence number printed on the firm's own website or a plumbing directory was loaded from the official CSLB License Detail endpoint (source S01) and transcribed field by field. Nothing here is copied from a directory's summary; directories were used only to obtain the licence NUMBER.
verification_rule: A row is 'verified_active' only if the CSLB License Detail page said 'This license is current and active.' Any other status is transcribed verbatim and the row is marked not usable.
not_verified_because: Service area (does this firm work at this address) - CSLB publishes address of record, not service area.
Whether the firm will perform the work without a permit - not published anywhere, and must not be asked in writing.
Review ratings - yelp.com returned HTTP 403 to automated requests this session.
Price for this job - no firm has quoted; only the three owner-reported numbers exist.
